Name: HillTop Farm Imrpoved
Author: XPeterPants
Description:
This mod Improves the HillTop Farm.

- It removes the huge cliff adding more farm space.
- It added a new passageway to grandfathers shrine near the river.
- It moved the ramp on the hill to the right side a.
- It Moved that annoying small pong to the bottom right of the farm making it a small fishing area where you can actually get fish. Also added a small cave.
- Aesthetically Improved Overall

Make sure to use the HillTop Farm for it to work or apply and a new save file is highly suggested.

!   Requires TMXL Map Toolkit   ! 

Made By PeterPants29
